evals.prompt: Design the main character for my film: Ana, a 30-year-old lighthouse keeper in 1950s Portugal. I need a character sheet for AI image generation.
evals.expected_output: A character file with a complete record: character and record: costume, identity locks within word limits, and turnaround/expression sheet specs.
expectations: A 'record: character' block includes height_cm, identity_lock, face, hair, eyes, silhouette and distinguishing_features
The identity lock is 40-80 words and contains no emotion or personality words
A costume record with materials and colors with hex values is included
A turnaround sheet spec lists front, three-quarter, side, three-quarter back and back views

evals.prompt: Here's the generated turnaround for Ana. The scar is on the right cheek in the side view but on the left in the front view. Is it approved?
evals.expected_output: A drift review that flags the mirror-flip, gives a FIX verdict with a single targeted instruction, and does not approve.
expectations: The scar side inconsistency is identified explicitly
A single targeted fix instruction is given that keeps everything else unchanged
The response refers to the approved spec for the correct side

evals.prompt: My film has three kids who are siblings. Make sure they don't get mixed up in wide shots.
evals.expected_output: Distinct silhouettes, unique color anchors per character, height lineup, and a lineup sheet spec.
expectations: Each sibling has a different silhouette description
Each sibling has a color anchor not shared with the others
Heights in cm are given and differ
A lineup sheet at one scale is specified
